object.name: Gamma Cephei A
object.notes: Corrected CNS5 5833; exact source identity * gam Cep. Former system source snapshot, shared as an approximate component position and proper motion. No resolved orbital trajectory is claimed. The orbit analysis identifies a stellar secondary. Its inferred M4 class and mass depend on the primary model and are withheld here. The planet remains outside this stellar-component card. Reviewed membership and individual physical parameters: arXiv:astro-ph/0609638. Individually reviewed physical values/withholding: arXiv:astro-ph/0609638; supersedes blended-source values for these fields. Withheld individual fields: temperature_k, luminosity_solar, radius_solar, metallicity_dex, age_gyr, absolute_mag. Reviewed component supplement: Component-specific published measurements supersede earlier withholding of aggregate measurements. No parent flux or unreviewed individual velocity is copied. The binary orbital gamma is adopted as shared bulk RV; individual orbital velocities and phase are not represented. Adopted fields: mass_solar: 2007A&A...462..777N:Table 2 (dynamical); radial_velocity_kms: 2007A&A...462..777N:Table 2 (systemic-approximation). Reviewed companion expansion of western-constellation-stars: Gamma Cephei A; adopted nearest-1000:cns5-5833.
